008package paint.fiji.trackmate;
009
010import javax.swing.*;
011import javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder;
012import java.awt.*;
013import java.awt.event.WindowAdapter;
014import java.awt.event.WindowEvent;
015import java.util.ArrayList;
016import java.util.Collections;
017import java.util.List;
018import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
019
020/**
021 * Provides a modeless dialog for running TrackMate on a single recording with interactive
022 * threshold adjustment.
023 * <p>
024 * The dialog allows users to:
025 * </p>
026 * <ul>
027 *   <li>Select a recording from the current project/experiment.</li>
028 *   <li>Adjust the spot detection threshold via a slider.</li>
029 *   <li>Trigger TrackMate calculation in a background thread.</li>
030 *   <li>Save the resulting track and spot data to CSV.</li>
031 * </ul>
032 * <p>
033 * It provides visual feedback during long-running TrackMate operations and prevents concurrent
034 * execution through UI-state management.
035 * </p>
036 * <ul>
037 *   <li>Interactive recording selection and threshold tuning.</li>
038 *   <li>Background thread execution for responsive UI.</li>
039 *   <li>Status feedback with animated dots for active processes.</li>
040 * </ul>
041 */
042public class TrackMateSingleDialog extends JDialog {
043
044    public interface CalculationHandler {
045        void run(String recordingName, int threshold) throws Exception;
046    }
047
048    public interface SaveHandler {
049        void run(String recordingName, int threshold) throws Exception;
050    }
051
052    private final ButtonGroup        recordingGroup   = new ButtonGroup();
053    private final List<JRadioButton> recordingButtons = new ArrayList<>();
054
055    private final JSlider thresholdSlider;
056    private final JLabel  thresholdValueLabel;
057    private final JLabel  statusLabel;
058
059    private volatile Thread  runningThread;
060    private volatile Thread  dotThread;
061    private volatile boolean dotRunning;
062
063    private String selectedRecordingName;
064    private int    selectedThreshold;
065
066    public interface ThresholdProvider {
067        int getThreshold(String recordingName);
068    }
069
070    private ThresholdProvider thresholdProvider;
071
072    public void setThresholdProvider(ThresholdProvider p) {
073        this.thresholdProvider = p;
074        applyThresholdFromProvider(); // set slider for current selection immediately
075    }
076
077    public TrackMateSingleDialog(
078            Window             owner,
079            List<String>       recordingNames,
080            String             initialRecordingName,
081            int                initialThreshold,
082            CalculationHandler onCalculate,
083            SaveHandler        onSave
084    ) {
085        super(owner, "TrackMate Single", ModalityType.MODELESS);
086
087        List<String> names = (recordingNames == null)
088                ? Collections.<String>emptyList()
089                : new ArrayList<>(recordingNames);
090
091        setDefaultCloseOperation(WindowConstants.DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE);
092        addWindowListener(new WindowAdapter() {
093            @Override
094            public void windowClosing(WindowEvent e) {
095                handleCancel(); // same behavior as Cancel button
096            }
097        });
098
099        JPanel root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(10, 10));
100        root.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(12, 12, 12, 12));
101        setContentPane(root);
102
103        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
104        // Left: recordings
105        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
106        JPanel recordingsPanel = new JPanel();
107        recordingsPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(recordingsPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
108        recordingsPanel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createTitledBorder("Recording"));
109
110        boolean anySelected = false;
111        String preferred = safeTrim(initialRecordingName);
112
113        for (String name : names) {
114            if (name == null) continue;
115            final String rec = name.trim();
116            if (rec.isEmpty()) {
117                continue;
118            }
119
120            JRadioButton rb = new JRadioButton(rec);
121            rb.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
122
123            // Select preferred if matches
124            if (!preferred.isEmpty() && preferred.equals(rec)) {
125                rb.setSelected(true);
126                anySelected = true;
127                selectedRecordingName = rec;
128            }
129
130            rb.addActionListener(e -> {
131                selectedRecordingName = rec;
132                applyThresholdFromProvider();
133            });
134
135            recordingGroup.add(rb);
136            recordingButtons.add(rb);
137            recordingsPanel.add(rb);
138        }
139
140        // Fallback: select first if nothing selected
141        if (!anySelected && !recordingButtons.isEmpty()) {
142            JRadioButton first = recordingButtons.get(0);
143            first.setSelected(true);
144            selectedRecordingName = first.getText();
145        }
146
147        JScrollPane recordingsScroll = new JScrollPane(
148                recordingsPanel,
149                JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED,
150                JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER
151        );
152        recordingsScroll.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(420, 320));
153        recordingsScroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
154
155        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
156        // Right: threshold slider
157        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
158        JPanel thresholdPanel = new JPanel();
159        thresholdPanel.setLayout(new BoxLayout(thresholdPanel, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
160        thresholdPanel.setBorder(
161                BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
162                        BorderFactory.createTitledBorder("Threshold"),
163                        new EmptyBorder(8, 12, 8, 8) // top, left, bottom, right
164                )
165        );
166        // thresholdPanel.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(8));
167
168        int initT = clamp(initialThreshold, 1, 50);
169
170        thresholdValueLabel = new JLabel(String.valueOf(initT));
171        thresholdValueLabel.setFont(thresholdValueLabel.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD, 18f));
172        thresholdValueLabel.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
173
174        thresholdSlider = new JSlider(0, 50, Math.max(1, initT));
175        thresholdSlider.setMajorTickSpacing(10);
176        thresholdSlider.setMinorTickSpacing(0);     // no fine ticks
177        thresholdSlider.setPaintTicks(true);
178        thresholdSlider.setPaintLabels(true);
179        thresholdSlider.setSnapToTicks(false);
180
181        thresholdSlider.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
182
183        thresholdSlider.addChangeListener(e -> {
184            int v = thresholdSlider.getValue();
185
186            // Prevent selecting 0
187            if (v == 0) {
188                thresholdSlider.setValue(1);
189                v = 1;
190            }
191
192            thresholdValueLabel.setText(String.valueOf(v));
193        });
194
195        thresholdPanel.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(6));
196        thresholdPanel.add(thresholdValueLabel);
197        thresholdPanel.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(12));
198        thresholdPanel.add(thresholdSlider);
199        thresholdPanel.add(Box.createVerticalGlue());
200
201        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
202        // Center layout
203        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
204        JPanel center = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(10, 10));
205        center.add(recordingsScroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
206        center.add(thresholdPanel, BorderLayout.EAST);
207        root.add(center, BorderLayout.CENTER);
208
209        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
210        // Bottom buttons: Calculate / Save / Cancel
211        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
212        statusLabel = new JLabel(" ");
213        statusLabel.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(0, 0, 6, 0));
214
215        JButton calculateBtn = new JButton("Calculate");
216        JButton saveBtn      = new JButton("Save");
217        JButton cancelBtn    = new JButton("Cancel");
218
219        calculateBtn.addActionListener(e -> {
220            if (!captureSelections()) {
221                Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
222                return;
223            }
224            if (runningThread != null) {
225                Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
226                return;
227            }
228
229            setUiRunning(true, "Running…");
230
231            runningThread = new Thread(() -> {
232                startDots();
233                try {
234                    if (onCalculate != null) {
235                        onCalculate.run(selectedRecordingName, selectedThreshold);
236                    }
237
238                    if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
239                        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> setUiRunning(false, "Cancelled"));
240                        return;
241                    }
242
243                    SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> setUiRunning(false, "Completed"));
244                } catch (Exception ex) {
245                    if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
246                        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> setUiRunning(false, "Cancelled"));
247                    } else {
248                        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> setUiRunning(false, "Failed: " + ex.getMessage()));
249                    }
250                } finally {
251                    stopDots();
252                    runningThread = null;
253                }
254            }, "TrackMateSingle-Worker");
255
256            runningThread.start();
257        });
258
259        saveBtn.addActionListener(e -> {
260            if (!captureSelections()) {
261                Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
262                return;
263            }
264            if (runningThread != null) {
265                Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().beep();
266                return;
267            }
268            try {
269                if (onSave != null) {
270                    onSave.run(selectedRecordingName, selectedThreshold);
271                }
272                statusLabel.setText("Saved");
273            } catch (Exception ex) {
274                statusLabel.setText("Save failed: " + ex.getMessage());
275            }
276        });
277
278        cancelBtn.addActionListener(e -> handleCancel());
279
280        JPanel buttons = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 8, 0));
281        buttons.add(calculateBtn);
282        buttons.add(saveBtn);
283        buttons.add(cancelBtn);
284
285        JPanel bottom = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
286        bottom.add(statusLabel, BorderLayout.WEST);
287        bottom.add(buttons, BorderLayout.EAST);
288
289        root.add(bottom, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
290
291        // store initial
292        selectedThreshold = thresholdSlider.getValue();
293
294        pack();
295        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
296
297        // local helpers that need button refs
298        this.calculateBtn = calculateBtn;
299        this.saveBtn = saveBtn;
300        this.cancelBtn = cancelBtn;
301    }
302
303    // keep refs for enabling/disabling
304    private final JButton calculateBtn;
305    private final JButton saveBtn;
306    private final JButton cancelBtn;
307
308    private void handleCancel() {
309        Thread t = runningThread;
310        if (t != null) {
311            // first Cancel interrupts running job (dialog stays open)
312            statusLabel.setText("Stopping…");
313            stopDots();
314            t.interrupt();
315            return;
316        }
317        dispose();
318    }
319
320    private void setUiRunning(boolean running, String status) {
321        statusLabel.setText(status);
322        calculateBtn.setEnabled(!running);
323        saveBtn.setEnabled(!running);
324        cancelBtn.setEnabled(true);
325        thresholdSlider.setEnabled(!running);
326        for (JRadioButton rb : recordingButtons) rb.setEnabled(!running);
327    }
328
329    private boolean captureSelections() {
330        String rec = selectedRecordingName;
331        if (rec == null || rec.trim().isEmpty()) {
332            for (JRadioButton rb : recordingButtons) {
333                if (rb.isSelected()) {
334                    rec = rb.getText();
335                    break;
336                }
337            }
338        }
339        if (rec == null || rec.trim().isEmpty()) {
340            return false;
341        }
342
343        selectedRecordingName = rec.trim();
344        selectedThreshold     = thresholdSlider.getValue();
345        return true;
346    }
347
348    private static int clamp(int v, int lo, int hi) {
349        if (v < lo) {
350            return lo;
351        }
352        if (v > hi) {
353            return hi;
354        }
355        return v;
356    }
357
358    private static String safeTrim(String s) {
359        return s == null ? "" : s.trim();
360    }
361
362    private void applyThresholdFromProvider() {
363        if (thresholdProvider == null) {
364            return;
365        }
366        if (selectedRecordingName == null || selectedRecordingName.trim().isEmpty()) {
367            return;
368        }
369
370        int v = thresholdProvider.getThreshold(selectedRecordingName.trim());
371        if (v < 1) {
372            v = 1;
373        }
374        if (v > 50) {
375            v = 50;
376        }
377
378        thresholdSlider.setValue(v); // your changeListener will also update label & enforce 0->1
379    }
380
381    private void startDots() {
382        if (dotThread != null && dotThread.isAlive()) {
383            return;
384        }
385        if (dotRunning) {
386            return;
387        }
388        dotRunning = true;
389        dotThread = new Thread(() -> {
390            int dots = 0;
391            while (dotRunning && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
392                try {
393                    Thread.sleep(1000);
394                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
395                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
396                    break;
397                }
398
399                if (!dotRunning) break;
400
401                PaintLogger.raw(".");
402                dots++;
403
404                if (dots >= 80) {
405                    PaintLogger.raw("\n                                                    ");
406                    dots = 0;
407                }
408            }
409        }, "TrackMateSingle-Dots");
410
411        dotThread.setDaemon(true);
412        dotThread.start();
413    }
414
415    private void stopDots() {
416        dotRunning = false;
417        Thread t = dotThread;
418        if (t != null) {
419            t.interrupt();
420        }
421        dotThread = null;
422    }
423
424    @Override
425    public void dispose() {
426        stopDots();
427        super.dispose();
428    }
429}
